title: Record that the R439 scalar drop leaves the paid histogram unchanged
body:
## Summary
- The four recorded R439 words have native ADD counts 11,783, 11,515, 11,500 and 11,715. Each word has nine rank-7 copies.
- The owner check compares every word with one paid profile of rank mass 5,129. The certificate claims no new kappa.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. The 661-column replay is not rerun.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/r439-scalar-histogram/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/r439-scalar-histogram/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-scalar-histogram`
